items.title: The comparison map beta between the stalk of K and the cohomology of the Milnor fibre is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the comparison map beta, after pulling back along i, with the stalk-level map alpha of the definition of local acyclicity (statement lines 19419-19422). The proof (proof lines 19424-19462) reduces to a strictly henselian base, computes the stalk of i^{-1}beta at a geometric point using the stalk-pullback lemma and the identification of the Milnor fibre with the strict henselisation of X at the point, and concludes with the stalk criterion for isomorphisms. H2: one base change reduction and one stalk computation, both written out.
